content.rendered:
Wedding for Stephen & Klarissa Chen at The Bay Club in San Jose
Name: Stephen Chen
Address: New York New York
Event: Wedding
Guests: 90
Date: Saturday, June 07, 2014

5PM Lunch – BAY CLUB SAN JOSE DJ (S&K have venue from 10am-5pm)

Desserts will be dropped off to you btwn 10am and 1pm

2 large boxes and 5 smaller boxes – total of 204 cup cakes

three flavors – carrot, marble, red velvet

please place nicely on platter and display on dessert table

1:00 announce NOT for the first time mr and mrs chen – like to give a short toast

scrapbook page – pens on tables

Angela and Eric can leave front table – leave picture

– put sign in sheets in gift box and give gift box 1 to Chirsty Ying

S&K say hello – short welcome thank you

– thanks – out of town, parents, friends, family – everyone that helped shape us

1:10 S&K – invite Thomas up to Bless our food

1:13 Thomas does a quick prayer for our food

announce Bill Lee will give toast/speech

sister and brother of groom will give toast/speech

1:23 Emily/Jonathan [4 min total] – introduce brothers of bride

announces S&K will be coming around to take pictures – stay near your tables so they don’t miss you!

Photobooth closes at 3:30 make sure you get in there and contribute to their scrapbook

Also small pieces of paper for everyone to write a message on table – someone will collect at 2pm

1:40 S&K Table Rounds [40 min – 2 min per table]

1:50 Announce Jazlynn and Jalene will be coming by to collect all pens and note cards

2:00 Jazlynn and Jalene collect all note cards and pens

Lisa – check to make sure dessert table looks good – signs are in correct place

Jace – check to see where bar tab is at – how much $ do we have left

if a lot – find Thomas to annouce – DRINK UP

Announce Dessert – Bundt Cakes – help yourself [1 per person] – also coffee and tea

2:20 Jace – start setting up slide show

Jace – pack up slideshow stuff – get ready to bring to car

Announce Father Daughter Dance

Stephen waits when song is almost over for his dance

3:00 reminder photo booth closes at 3:30pm

3:30 announce S&K will be leaving

Play some country and some of the newer top 40 songs from this year

johnny rivers – slow dancing swaying to the music

Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic–The Police

I Wanna Dance with Somebody—Whitney Houston

Old Time Rock and Roll—Bob Seger & The Silver Bullet Band
